content.short: Stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the Indonesian rupiah, backed by cash and government bonds.
content.description: IDRX brings the Indonesian rupiah on-chain. Each token is redeemable for one rupiah and backed by fiat reserves and Indonesian government bonds held at regulated institutions, with audits and reserve reports published. It is registered with Indonesia's crypto futures exchange CFX, audited by CertiK, and available on several chains including Base and World Chain.
content.meta: IDRX is a regulated rupiah stablecoin backed 1:1 by cash and bonds, with published audits, on Base and World Chain.
